task.title: Interpret policy validation errors
task.shortdesc: Diagnose validation errors for unsupported policy, wrong value type, unknown entry, raw fallback, or affected policy path.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Validation errors are structured feedback about the selected Firefox schema channel and the exact policy or managed preference that BPM cannot accept as ready.

step.cmd: Read the affected policy path and message before changing values.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Classify the issue as unsupported policy, wrong value type, deprecated setting, unknown entry, imported value, or raw fallback.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Use All Settings or JSON to navigate to the affected location and correct only the reported value.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Revalidate the profile in the same schema channel before saving or exporting.

info.note: Do not edit internal storage, browser local data, database rows, or generated build artifacts to recover user-facing profile work.

result.p: The validation error is either resolved or documented as a deliberate raw/unsupported value that cannot be treated as release-ready.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the same error repeats after one clean retry, stop the workflow, preserve the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current surface for maintainer review.
